topic: Simple will vs dying without one (Paul vs Rose)

scenes.narration: Dying without a will costs families forty percent of the estate. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench holding a will document stamped SIMPLE WILL, comic burst banner reads FORTY PERCENT LOST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Paul and Rose are both fifty five with two hundred thousand in assets.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man paul and woman rose at separate kitchen tables, both with bank statements reading TWO HUNDRED THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each has a spouse and two adult children at home.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two family photo portraits side by side, each showing a couple with two adult children, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Paul says he will write a will eventually and puts it off.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, paul shrugging at a brochure labeled SIMPLE WILL FOR THREE HUNDRED, calendar pages flipping by behind him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He never updates beneficiaries on any retirement account either.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, paul's old retirement statement with a beneficiary line reading BLANK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rose pays three hundred dollars for a simple will today.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, rose at an attorney's desk signing a printed will, a fee paper labeled THREE HUNDRED beside her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She names beneficiaries on every account and stores copies safely.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, rose at a kitchen table updating a list labeled BENEFICIARIES across multiple accounts, a fire safe behind her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Years pass and tragedy strikes both of these families.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, calendar pages flipping forward, two solemn family photos side by side, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Paul's estate gets stuck in probate court for fourteen months.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, paul's family standing outside a courthouse holding a paper stamped PROBATE OPEN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His family pays eighty thousand dollars in legal fees and taxes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, paul's family staring at a tall invoice from a probate lawyer, comic banner reads EIGHTY THOUSAND IN FEES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rose's family inherits the full two hundred thousand in three weeks.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, rose's family at a kitchen table with a check stamped FULL INHERITANCE TWO HUNDRED THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Sign a simple will and name your beneficiaries. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel, holding up a will stamped SIGNED, comic banner reads PROTECT YOUR FAMILY, kids comic book illustration
